action: Change a data input of the PCA (inspector, Data tab)

action: Add the structural summary and press "Initiate Structural Analysis" in the Data tab
expected: The card first shows Team's placeholder, then draws the analysis

action: Add the heatmap and read the "Significant only" status note
expected: Disabled: the note gives Team's reason. Allowed: choosing it shows Team's "Showing N significant lipids" note

action: Add the FLA ratio distributions and add one index in a sel_<category> picker
expected: The card redraws with the added index

action: Restyle the violin (Appearance: title, Okabe–Ito palette, font size)

action: Violin statistics: Wilcoxon + BH, review, confirm; results table; download CSV

action: Resize and arrange (real drag, Tidy up), undo and redo once

action: Zoom in to 150 % or more with the zoom controls and look at the PCA
